definitions.gloss: smelting; refining; extraction of metal from ore
definitions.explanation: The industrial process of extracting pure metal from raw ore by heating and chemical treatment. Covers the entire process from raw ore to usable metal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{製錬|せいれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧{金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{製錬|せいれん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栄|さか}えた→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧。

examples.english: New smelting technology brought costs down.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (manufacture, produce) and {錬|れん} (refine, temper). Refers specifically to the process of extracting metal from ore — the first stage of turning raw mineral resources into usable metals.

The word is distinct from the homophone ⟦{精錬|せいれん}→精錬：21301_seiren⟧, which refers to the further purification of already-extracted metal to achieve higher purity. {製錬|せいれん} = ore → crude metal; ⟦{精錬|せいれん}→精錬：21301_seiren⟧ = crude metal → pure metal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {製錬|せいれん}{所|じょ}: smelting plant, smelter
- {製錬|せいれん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: smelting technology
- ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{製錬|せいれん}: copper smelting
- {製錬|せいれん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to smelt, to refine from ore

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精錬|せいれん}→精錬：21301_seiren⟧: refining, purification — a later stage that purifies crude metal further; homophone with different kanji
- ⟦{冶金|やきん}→冶金：24156_yakin⟧: metallurgy — the broader science and technology of working with metals
- ⟦{鋳造|ちゅうぞう}→鋳造：23244_chuuzou⟧: casting — shaping molten metal in molds, a different process entirely
